details: For finite concept classes. The singleton family gives an unbounded gap: $\mathrm{pOSC}=n-1$ while $\mathrm{OSC}=1$.
name: Proper Ordered Sample Compression / Order Sample Compression
proof: A proper ordered sample-compression scheme is an ordered sample-compression scheme with an additional properness requirement on reconstruction.  Minimizing over the restricted class of schemes cannot improve the optimum.
